hypothesis: Between-guide contrasts at the same targeted gene and lane remove guide-shared response components. Split-sample dose ratios estimate an on-target response slope rather than averaging complete treatment effects.
novelty: V31 pooled guide effects and uncertainties; V85 uses guide-to-guide response differences, an independent own-RNA first stage, an intercept-cancelling contrast, weak-dose abstention and conservative ratio uncertainty. This is an independent two-sample Wald-inspired predictor, not an identified causal effect or a reproduction of inspre/RICE.
source_eligibility: Exactly two assigned guide identities, >=2 shared lanes with >=4 cells each guide and >=20 NTCs; >=15 cells per guide per half across retained lanes. Within guide/lane, deterministic random halves of equal size; odd leftover cells omitted. Same harmonic cell-count lane weights for dose, response and both halves.
estimator: Aggregate within-lane guide1-minus-guide2 log2CPM differences with0.1 offset. Own-RNA dose estimated in opposite cell half to each trans-response contrast. Require both dose signs equal, each abs>=0.25log2 and F>=10, own control>5CPM. Average log2(.1)*response_B/dose_A and reverse. Delta-method variances use disjoint halves; maximal covariance bound plus split disagreement and0.0025 variance floor. Fixed0.25log2 signal-SD reliability. Nonpanel outputs expressed>5CPM only.
uncertainty_scope: Approximate finite-sample uncertainty and heuristic F screen, not a calibrated weak-IV test. Shared control/lane biology and off-target guide effects can violate exclusion. Binary assignment is not assumed randomized after cell survival.
prediction: Fixed quarter-strength reliability-weighted bounded+/-0.5log2 correction to study-excluded V66; own/panel effects unchanged. Existing80% identity guard; inactive rows exact baseline. Two source conditions weighted by nonpanel pairwise-valid NTC Spearman exp4rho. No query treatment values used.
controls: Pooled guide mean with original bounded dose normalization and exactly the primary output confidence; guide labels permuted within target/lane and re-estimated; cyclic target derangement restricted to supported targets.
recipient_boundaries: H1 excluded, HCT116+HEK293T jointly excluded from V66 baseline; D1/D3 baseline excludes all CD4 summaries, while new teacher explicitly uses D2 and is donor transfer, NOT unseen-lineage/whole-CD4 exclusion. D2 query recipients abstain. D3 is now a reused donor after V84, not blind.
development: 621 existing broad pairs (655 minus34 training-donor stimulated pairs). Require >=0.5% lower equal-study profile error, >=1% lower changed-target profile error, worst-study<=1.02, PDS loss<=0.005 on both full/affected panels, and better full/affected profile error than pooled and target-permuted controls. No tuning or model/strength selection from these outcomes.
counts: Primary diagnostic always: up to2 hash-first active targets per H1,HCT116,HEK293T,D1,D3 from metadata with>=200 actual cells and matching distinct NTC templates. Use400 if possible, otherwise available>=200; never duplicate cells. Count cohort frozen before scoring. Same seed/templates/library totals/residual10 for V66, contrast25, pooled25,target_permuted25. Guide-permuted response evaluated in means. One seed; a second seed only if original mean and count requirements all pass.
count_gates: Profile error must not rise; PDS loss<=0.005,FID loss<=0.002,reach loss<=0.005,JAC loss<=0.0005,NMAE<=1.01 when available; >=3 endpoints improve, beats pooled and target-permuted profile error. Every tested context reported; insufficient/undefined endpoints fail qualification. No hidden anchor conversion.
release: No package or upload unless both development and count gates pass and a separately confirmed second seed supports them. Novelty alone does not qualify.

literature.idea: Guide interventions as instruments; proposed transfer adaptation does not fit the paper causal network.
Instrument/control-function motivation only; no RICE model or checkpoint executed.
